Consider the following eigenvalues of the structure tensor at three image
       locations:

        Location      𝜆0         𝜆1

         P        0.01       0.02

        Q        0.01       5.00

        R        4.50       5.20

     Which location is most likely to be a corner?
originalSourceText:
Q.6   Consider the following eigenvalues of the structure tensor at three image
       locations:

        Location      𝜆0         𝜆1

         P        0.01       0.02

        Q        0.01       5.00

        R        4.50       5.20

     Which location is most likely to be a corner?

      (A) P

      (B) Q

      (C) R

      (D) All equally

      Explanation: In case of R both the eigen values are large → corner

      Refer Slide 28 of Lecture 33: Image Feature Extraction
